description: Somos un grupo de jóvenes estudiantes de ingeniería de primer semestre en la Anáhuac Mayab con un interés por la ciencia, y la tecnología. Estamos abiertas a nuevas experiencias y aprender nuevas cosas!
summary: This project develops a practical and accessible platform for children with the aim of fostering a genuine interest in science through their main hobbies, such as video games. Our challenge is to capture children's attention so they can learn about the artifacts built by humanity for extraterrestrial exploration, and to ensure their memories are not forgotten by future generations. We believe this is important because the youngest generation is currently growing up with critically high information overstimulation, which can negatively affect children's information retention and attention span.
details:
This role-playing video game immerses you in Mars, where you take control of a robot sent to the Red Planet to gather information from ancient prototypes stranded on the surface. Throughout your adventure, you will meet various robots that will provide you with relevant information. You will also discover Martian life passionate about human technology that will accompany you on this information-gathering odyssey. Along this entertaining journey, children will be able to genuinely grow their interest in science, specifically in topics related to astronomy. This will awaken a sense of curiosity in the child, indirectly countering the excessive stimulation of social media and unhelpful technology by showing them an engaging alternative hobby that can benefit their intellectual growth, information retention capacity, and concentration.

Regarding the development of this project, we used the drawing software Procreate to create our characters. We also used a 3D modeling software called Blender, where we designed the scenery and atmosphere. Finally, we used Visual Studio Code to write the program or code, which we eventually ran in Ren'Py. It is worth noting that this creative process is free of Artificial Intelligence, except for the support with parts of the code and help with debugging.
